core_obligations: Locality: to check the composite Lg^*Rf_*K to Rf'_*L(g')^*K to Rf'_*K' is an isomorphism, work locally on S', so assume g : S' to S is a morphism of affine schemes; then X is quasi-compact quasi-separated; state the induction claim for every quasi-compact open U of X with U' = (g')^{-1}(U) (proof lines 6771-6788).

Base case: if U is affine, the result holds by assumption, namely by Lemma single-complex-base-change-condition part (2) together with the algebraic translation by Lemmas affine-compare-bounded and quasi-coherence-pullback (proof lines 6789-6795).

Induction step: let X = U union V with U, V, U ∩ V quasi-compact and the result known for all three; using the relative Mayer-Vietoris triangles (Cohomology, Lemma unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris) form the commutative diagram relating Lg^*Rf_*K and Rf'_*K' to the corresponding objects for U, V, U ∩ V and their base changes (proof lines 6797-6816).

Conclude: the second and third horizontal arrows are isomorphisms by the induction hypothesis, hence so is the first by Derived Categories, Lemma third-isomorphism-triangle; the induction principle completes the proof (proof lines 6817-6821).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to affine g and set up the induction over quasi-compact opens (proof lines 6771-6788).
Base case from the equivalent conditions and the affine dictionary (proof lines 6789-6795).
Induction step via relative Mayer-Vietoris triangles (proof lines 6797-6816).
Conclude by the third isomorphism lemma for triangles (proof lines 6817-6821).
